Tuesday.title: Tuesday · Full-body strength A
Tuesday.badge: BALANCED FULL BODY · 1–2 CLEAN REPS LEFT
Tuesday.summary: High-bar squat · flat DB press · supported row · DB RDL · lateral raise

home.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
home.start: Hold one controllable dumbbell close to the chest; feet comfortably apart.
home.move: Sit between your hips, keep the whole foot down, then stand smoothly.
home.finish: Stand tall and lower the weight safely.
home.avoid: No bouncing, forced depth or lifted heels.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Grip/front loading may limit the legs before a machine would. It is a practical alternative, not a proven identical stimulus.

home.name: Dumbbell floor press
home.start: Lie on the floor with knees bent, dumbbells by your chest; use a load you can position safely.
home.move: Lower until upper arms gently meet the floor, then press without bouncing.
home.finish: Lower the weights deliberately and roll up safely.
home.avoid: Do not use the upright chair as a bench or drop weights.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Shorter bottom range than a bench press; progress its own load and reps.

home.name: One-arm dumbbell row
home.start: Place one hand on a stable wall-braced chair; both feet stay on the floor.
home.move: Keep the trunk still; pull the elbow toward your hip and lower under control.
home.finish: Set the dumbbell down before changing sides.
home.avoid: No unsecured chair or trunk rotation.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: The demonstration uses a bench back; your wall-braced chair is a support adaptation.

home.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
home.start: Stand tall with soft knees, weights close to thighs and ribs stacked.
home.move: Push hips back; stop where hamstrings load without losing control, then stand without leaning back.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
home.start: Stand stable with light dumbbells beside you and soft elbows.
home.move: Lift arms to the sides through comfortable range; lower without swinging.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Free-weight resistance differs from cable tension; track this variation separately.

gym.name: High-bar back squat
gym.start: Use a rated squat rack with safeties set below your comfortable depth. Center the bar on the upper traps; brace.
gym.move: Sit down between the hips with the whole foot grounded; stand smoothly with knees tracking comfortably.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
gym.start: Use a rated bench, feet planted and dumbbells safely positioned by the shoulders.
gym.move: Lower under control through a comfortable range, then press with wrists stacked over elbows.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Chest-supported row
gym.start: Set a rated chest support so your arms hang freely.
gym.move: Keep chest supported; pull elbows back without jerking, then lower smoothly.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
gym.start: Stand tall with soft knees, weights close to thighs and ribs stacked.
gym.move: Push hips back; stop where hamstrings load without losing control, then stand without leaning back.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Cable lateral raise
gym.start: Set a low cable and stand stable with a light load.
gym.move: Raise the arm out to the side through comfortable shoulder range; lower without swinging.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

prep.name: ATG wall tibialis raise
prep.cue: Back against a wall, feet close enough to stay easy, heels grounded. Lift toes slowly, pause briefly, lower under control. Stop before fatigue or pain; use non-slip footing.

prep.name: Banded ankle dorsiflexion
prep.cue: Band low across the front of the ankle, anchored securely behind; move the knee forward with heel down. Skip the band if no safe anchor.

prep.name: Lunge with thoracic rotation
prep.cue: Use a comfortable lunge and rotate through the upper back; use support and do not force depth.

prep.name: Brief goblet squat ankle stretch
prep.cue: Use a light load, comfortable squat depth and heel-down knee motion; do not fatigue the legs.

prep.name: Band pull-apart
prep.cue: Use a light band; pull apart without shrugging or arching.

prep.name: Loop-band external rotation
prep.cue: Keep elbows near the sides; rotate forearms outward using light resistance. No wall anchor needed.

cooldown.name: Comfortable couch stretch
cooldown.cue: Pad the rear knee, use stable support and breathe normally. Shorten or stop before knee pain or excessive tension.

cooldown.name: Gentle supine strap-assisted hamstring stretch
cooldown.cue: Lie down; use a towel/strap behind the leg and gently straighten the knee without forcing it. No nerve-tension treatment is prescribed.

cooldown.name: Wall-supported shoulder flexion rocking
cooldown.cue: Support hands on a wall, move hips back gently and return through comfortable overhead range. No forceful pressure or “smashing.”

home.name: Dumbbell deadlift

home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Standing dumbbell overhead press

home.move: Press upward without leaning back; lower smoothly to shoulder height.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: One-arm dumbbell row · lat-pull alternative

home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Bulgarian split squat

home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.start: Stand tall with light dumbbells and upper arms near the torso.

home.name: Dumbbell deadlift
home.start: Place dumbbells on the floor beside the feet or stable raised blocks; use a reach you can control.
home.move: Bend knees and hips to take the weights, brace, then stand smoothly. Reset between reps; this is not a straight-leg RDL.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Dumbbell load and starting height differ from barbell deadlifts; do not copy barbell weights.

home.name: Standing dumbbell overhead press
home.start: Stand stable with overhead clearance and weights you can safely get to the shoulders.
home.move: Press upward without leaning back; lower smoothly to shoulder height.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: One-arm dumbbell row · lat-pull alternative
home.start: Place one hand on a stable wall-braced chair; both feet stay on the floor.
home.move: Keep the trunk still; pull the elbow toward your hip and lower under control.
home.finish: Set the dumbbell down before changing sides.
home.avoid: No unsecured chair or trunk rotation.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Temporary home pulling option, not a vertical pull. A safely installed pull-up bar or rated cable/band setup is needed for that exact pattern.

home.name: Bulgarian split squat
home.rest: 90–120 sec between rounds; longer if needed
home.start: Use low, stable rear-foot support secured against movement; find a balanced stance with light or no load.
home.move: Bend the front hip and knee through controlled depth; push through the front foot to stand. Use hand support if needed.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Alternating dumbbell curl
home.rest: Pair with triceps; 60–90 sec after both
home.start: Stand tall with light dumbbells and upper arms near the torso.
home.move: Curl without swinging the trunk; lower fully under control. Pair with the next movement only if technique stays steady.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Seated overhead dumbbell triceps extension

home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
home.start: Hold one controllable dumbbell close to the chest; feet comfortably apart.

home.finish: Stand tall and lower the weight safely.

home.avoid: Do not use the upright chair as a bench or drop weights.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

Tuesday.title: Tuesday · Full-body strength A

home.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
home.start: Hold one controllable dumbbell close to the chest; feet comfortably apart.
home.move: Sit between your hips, keep the whole foot down, then stand smoothly.
home.finish: Stand tall and lower the weight safely.
home.avoid: No bouncing, forced depth or lifted heels.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Grip/front loading may limit the legs before a machine would. It is a practical alternative, not a proven identical stimulus.

home.name: Dumbbell floor press
home.start: Lie on the floor with knees bent, dumbbells by your chest; use a load you can position safely.
home.move: Lower until upper arms gently meet the floor, then press without bouncing.
home.finish: Lower the weights deliberately and roll up safely.
home.avoid: Do not use the upright chair as a bench or drop weights.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Shorter bottom range than a bench press; progress its own load and reps.

home.name: One-arm dumbbell row
home.start: Place one hand on a stable wall-braced chair; both feet stay on the floor.
home.move: Keep the trunk still; pull the elbow toward your hip and lower under control.
home.finish: Set the dumbbell down before changing sides.
home.avoid: No unsecured chair or trunk rotation.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: The demonstration uses a bench back; your wall-braced chair is a support adaptation.

home.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
home.start: Stand tall with soft knees, weights close to thighs and ribs stacked.
home.move: Push hips back; stop where hamstrings load without losing control, then stand without leaning back.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Dumbbell lateral raise

home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.

home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

Tuesday.title: Tuesday · Full-body strength A
Tuesday.badge: BALANCED FULL BODY · 1–2 CLEAN REPS LEFT
Tuesday.summary: High-bar squat · flat DB press · supported row · DB RDL · lateral raise

home.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
home.start: Hold one controllable dumbbell close to the chest; feet comfortably apart.
home.move: Sit between your hips, keep the whole foot down, then stand smoothly.
home.finish: Stand tall and lower the weight safely.
home.avoid: No bouncing, forced depth or lifted heels.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Grip/front loading may limit the legs before a machine would. It is a practical alternative, not a proven identical stimulus.

home.name: Dumbbell floor press
home.start: Lie on the floor with knees bent, dumbbells by your chest; use a load you can position safely.
home.move: Lower until upper arms gently meet the floor, then press without bouncing.
home.finish: Lower the weights deliberately and roll up safely.
home.avoid: Do not use the upright chair as a bench or drop weights.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Shorter bottom range than a bench press; progress its own load and reps.

home.name: One-arm dumbbell row
home.start: Place one hand on a stable wall-braced chair; both feet stay on the floor.
home.move: Keep the trunk still; pull the elbow toward your hip and lower under control.
home.finish: Set the dumbbell down before changing sides.
home.avoid: No unsecured chair or trunk rotation.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: The demonstration uses a bench back; your wall-braced chair is a support adaptation.

home.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
home.start: Stand tall with soft knees, weights close to thighs and ribs stacked.
home.move: Push hips back; stop where hamstrings load without losing control, then stand without leaning back.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

home.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
home.start: Stand stable with light dumbbells beside you and soft elbows.
home.move: Lift arms to the sides through comfortable range; lower without swinging.
home.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
home.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
home.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.
home.limitation: Free-weight resistance differs from cable tension; track this variation separately.

gym.name: High-bar back squat
gym.start: Use a rated squat rack with safeties set below your comfortable depth. Center the bar on the upper traps; brace.
gym.move: Sit down between the hips with the whole foot grounded; stand smoothly with knees tracking comfortably.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
gym.start: Use a rated bench, feet planted and dumbbells safely positioned by the shoulders.
gym.move: Lower under control through a comfortable range, then press with wrists stacked over elbows.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Chest-supported row
gym.start: Set a rated chest support so your arms hang freely.
gym.move: Keep chest supported; pull elbows back without jerking, then lower smoothly.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
gym.start: Stand tall with soft knees, weights close to thighs and ribs stacked.
gym.move: Push hips back; stop where hamstrings load without losing control, then stand without leaning back.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

gym.name: Cable lateral raise
gym.start: Set a low cable and stand stable with a light load.
gym.move: Raise the arm out to the side through comfortable shoulder range; lower without swinging.
gym.finish: Finish the repetition under control and put the load down safely.
gym.avoid: Do not grind through lost control or sharp pain. Choose a lighter load or shorter comfortable range.
gym.progress: Reach the top of the range on every set with 1–2 clean reps left; increase by the smallest feasible increment, not a mandatory 5–10 lb.

prep.name: ATG wall tibialis raise
prep.cue: Back against a wall, feet close enough to stay easy, heels grounded. Lift toes slowly, pause briefly, lower under control. Stop before fatigue or pain; use non-slip footing.

prep.name: Banded ankle dorsiflexion
prep.cue: Band low across the front of the ankle, anchored securely behind; move the knee forward with heel down. Skip the band if no safe anchor.

prep.name: Lunge with thoracic rotation
prep.cue: Use a comfortable lunge and rotate through the upper back; use support and do not force depth.

prep.name: Brief goblet squat ankle stretch
prep.cue: Use a light load, comfortable squat depth and heel-down knee motion; do not fatigue the legs.

prep.name: Band pull-apart
prep.cue: Use a light band; pull apart without shrugging or arching.

prep.name: Loop-band external rotation
prep.cue: Keep elbows near the sides; rotate forearms outward using light resistance. No wall anchor needed.

cooldown.name: Comfortable couch stretch
cooldown.cue: Pad the rear knee, use stable support and breathe normally. Shorten or stop before knee pain or excessive tension.

cooldown.name: Gentle supine strap-assisted hamstring stretch
cooldown.cue: Lie down; use a towel/strap behind the leg and gently straighten the knee without forcing it. No nerve-tension treatment is prescribed.

cooldown.name: Wall-supported shoulder flexion rocking
cooldown.cue: Support hands on a wall, move hips back gently and return through comfortable overhead range. No forceful pressure or “smashing.”
